seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧एह् कीं कम्म करदा ऐ.⟦/1⟧ हल्दी दा अपना पीला रंग, करक्यूमिन, पानी च मुश्कल्लें घुलदा ऐ, इस करी पाउडर डुब्बी जंदा ऐ ते पानी गी बस हल्का रंगदा ऐ. मेटानिल येलो जनेह् रंग सौखे घुली जंदे न ते पानी गी झट्ट रंगी दिंदे न.
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, dissolves in water with difficulty, so the powder sinks and only lightly colours the water. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧एह् के नेईं फड़दा.⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट ते चाक बी पानी च नेईं घुलदे, इस करी इंदे कन्नै रलाई दी हल्दी इस जांच च पास होई सकदी ऐ. सिर्फ लैब टेस्ट गै पक्का दस्सी सकदा ऐ जे एह् इस च नेईं न.
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this does not catch.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can tell for sure that these are not in it.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: बड़ा बारीक पाउडर किश चिर पानी गी धुंधला रक्खी सकदा ऐ. धुंधला होना ठीक ऐ; दिक्खना एह् ऐ जे पानी साफ ते गूढ़ा पीला ते नेईं.
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. Being cloudy is fine; what to see is whether the water is clear and dark yellow.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: जांच 2: जेकर तुस साबत हल्दी खरीददे ओ
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: सुक्की हल्दी दी इक गंढ गी अद्धे च तोड़ो. हल्दी अंदर तगर पीली-संतरी होंदी ऐ, इस करी अंदरला हिस्सा बाह्रले आंह्गर गै लब्भना चाहिदा. फिक्के जां मद्धम अंदरले हिस्से उप्पर चमकीली पीली छिल्ल दा मतलब होई सकदा ऐ जे उप्परले पासे रंग पाया गेआ. बेचने आह्ले कोला इस बारै पुच्छो, जां टेस्ट करोआओ.
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a knob of dry turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through to the inside, so the inner part should look the same as the outer. A bright yellow skin over a dull or faint inner part can mean that colour was added on the outer side. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: स्टार्च कन्नै मिलने पर आयोडीन नीला-काला होई जंदा ऐ, ते हल्दी च आटा फड़ने आस्तै अक्सर इसदी सलाह् दित्ती जंदी ऐ. पर हल्दी आपूं स्टार्च आह्ली होंदी ऐ, इस करी एह् दौनें सूरतें च नीला-काला होई जंदा ऐ. इस्सै करी FSSAI दी अपनी पुस्तिका आयोडीन टेस्ट हल्दी गी छोड़ियै दूए पिस्से दे मसालें आस्तै बरतदी ऐ.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: On meeting starch iodine turns blue-black, and it is often advised for catching flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself is starchy, so it turns blue-black in both cases. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हल्दी च लेड, मेटानिल येलो ते चाक आस्तै FSSAI दे टेस्टें च गाढ़ा हाइड्रोक्लोरिक जां सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड बरतोंदा ऐ. एह् एसिड चमड़ी ते अक्खीं गी साड़ी दिंदे न. एह् लैब दी चीज न, रसोई दी नेईं.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. These are lab things, not kitchen things.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: पक्के जवाब आस्तै: फूड टेस्टिंग लैब
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL-मान्यता आह्ली फूड टेस्टिंग लैब हल्दी च लेड ते पाए दे रंगें दा टेस्ट करी सकदी ऐ. लैब कोला पुच्छो जे कितना नमूना चाहिदा, पाउडर गी उसदे बंद पैक च जां साफ बंद थैली च रक्खो, ते पैक पर छपे दा बैच नंबर लिखी लैओ. FSSAI अपनी वेबसाइट पर अधिसूचित फूड टेस्टिंग लैबें दी लिस्ट छापदा ऐ.
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI लाइसेंस जां रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर. तुस इसी FSSAI दी FoSCoS वेबसाइट पर दिक्खी सकदे ओ.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: जिसने इसी बनाया जां पैक कीता, उसदा नां ते पता.
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: कुल मात्रा, MRP, बैच जां लाट नंबर, ते बेस्ट-बिफोर तरीक.
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Total quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: एह् कुत्थें उगाई गेई. बक्ख-बक्ख इलाकें दी हल्दी दा रंग बक्ख होंदा ऐ, इस करी इलाके दा नां होने कन्नै तुस इक जनेही चीजें दी तुलना करी सकदे ओ.
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions has different colour, so having the region's name lets you compare similar things.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पैक दी जिप बंद रक्खो, जां पाउडर गी सुक्के, हवाबंद डब्बे च पाई देओ.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or put the powder in a dry, airtight box.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: सुक्का चमचा बरतो. सिल्ला चमचा गै हल्दी च डले बनांदा ऐ.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: इसी सिद्धी धुप्पै शा दूर रक्खो, जेह्ड़ी रंग फिक्का करदी ऐ.
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep it away from direct sunlight, which fades the colour.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: के बड़ी चमकीली पीली हल्दी माड़ा नशान ऐ?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: अपने आप च नेईं. रंग किस्म, उगाने दी थाह्र, ते इसी कि'यां सुकाया ते पीसेआ गेआ, इस पर बदलदा ऐ, इस करी हल्दियें च मता फर्क होंदा ऐ. ध्यान इस गल्लै दा रक्खो जे रंग पाउडर गी बड़ा सौखा ते नेईं छोड़ी दिंदा, जि'यां पानी आह्ली जांच च.
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. The colour changes with variety, growing place, and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. Watch whether the colour leaves the powder very easily, as in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: के पानी आह्ली जांच दस्सी सकदी ऐ जे हल्दी च लेड नेईं ऐ?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check tell that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: नेईं. लेड क्रोमेट पानी च नेईं घुलदा, इस करी पानी आह्ली जांच उसी नेईं दिक्खी सकदी. सिर्फ लैब टेस्ट गै दिक्खी सकदा ऐ.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can see it.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.t: हल्दी च डले कीं बनी जंदे न?
seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: नमी. गिल्ला चमचा जां खुल्ला पैक पाउडर गी पानी खिच्चन दिंदा ऐ. डलें गी सुक्के चमचे कन्नै तोड़ो ते पैक बंद रक्खो.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder pull in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: जेकर कोई जांच ठीक नेईं लग्गै तां के करां?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If some check does not seem right, what should I do?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: उस बैच दा बरतना बंद करो, पैक संभाली रक्खो, ते बैच नंबर कन्नै बेचने आह्ले कन्नै गल्ल करो. तुस FSSAI गी उसदे Food Safety Connect ऐप राहें बी शकैत करी सकदे ओ. जेकर एह् साढ़ी ऐ, तां असें गी पैक ते गलास दी फोटो WhatsApp करो.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack aside, and talk to the seller with the batch number. You can also complain to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: एह् जांचां साढ़ी हल्दी पर बी करो. जेकर किश बी ठीक नेईं लग्गै, तां पैक परा बैच नंबर कन्नै इक फोटो ⟦1⟧असें गी WhatsApp करो⟦/1⟧.
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric too. If anything does not seem right, then ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
